text: Android unit tests: rare native SIGSEGV in the bundled SQLite (sqlite3DbMallocRawNN) from a leaked activeLists collector during testDebugUnitTest

Root cause: RoomDatabase.close() closes every connection at once, so a query still running natively on another thread (a view model's activeLists collector on Dispatchers.IO) is a use-after-free. Fix on main (HEAD 9c8f2c24): closeWhenIdle() in app/src/test cancels the view models, waits for them, flushes the registry, then closes; 24 test files switched; three consecutive full runs green; pitfall recorded in AGENTS.md. Full gate green.
